title: Handoff: Local-first Skills examples
purpose: Help beginner developers practice Skills packaging and usage patterns while hosted Skill upload is waiting for release/access.
audience: Innovation workshop developers, solution engineers, and teams adopting reusable agent workflows.
change_summary: Added request-shape examples for local Skills, inline Skills, and curated Skill references, plus two mid-level Skill folders with scripts and references.
run_steps: Run `uv run openai_sdk/skills/local_skill_usage.py` to preview the local Skills request shape.
verification: Both bundled Skill scripts run with their example JSON inputs.
Live API calls remain disabled by default.
risks: Curated Skill IDs vary by model, provider, region, and release.
Inline and hosted shell examples need cloud support in the target environment.
Local shell mode requires application-owned command validation and audit logging.
open_questions: Which curated Skill IDs will be enabled in the workshop tenancy?
Which approval workflow should local shell commands use for team demos?
follow_up: Share this handoff in Slack with a request for reviewers to run the preview scripts and confirm the beginner flow.
